WHERE
  {   { ?var1  wdt:P31  wde:Q19796778 }
    UNION
      { ?var1  wdt:P16  wde:Q19796778 }
    ?var1  wdt:P131  ?var5

      { ?var1  wdt:P1824  ?var2 }
    BIND(strlen(str(?var2)) AS ?var6)
    BIND(substr(str(?var2), 1, 1) AS ?var7)
    BIND(substr(str(?var2), 2, ( ?var6 - 1 )) AS ?var8)
    BIND(replace(substr(str(?var8), 1, 4), "[A-Za-z ]", "") AS ?var9)
    BIND(strlen(str(?var9)) AS ?var10)
    BIND(concat(if(( ?var10 = 1 ), "000", if(( ?var10 = 2 ), "00", if(( ?var10 = 3 ), "0", ""))), str(?var9)) AS ?var11)
    BIND(concat(str(?var7), str(?var9)) AS ?var12)
    BIND(strlen(str(?var12)) AS ?var13)
    BIND(( ?var6 - ?var13 ) AS ?var14)
    BIND(substr(str(?var2), ( ?var13 + 1 ), ?var14) AS ?var15)
    BIND(concat(str(?var7), str(?var11), str(?var15)) AS ?var16)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?var5  wdt:P2586  ?var3 }
    OPTIONAL
      { SELECT DISTINCT  ?var1 (COUNT(?var5) AS ?var4)
        WHERE
          {   { ?var1  wdt:P31  wde:Q19796778 }
            UNION
              { ?var1  wdt:P16  wde:Q19796778 }

        GROUP BY ?var1
      }

ORDER BY ASC(?var16) ASC(?var3) DESC(?var4)

    ?var6  wdt:P50    wde:Q22990398 .
